name: pcb-shell-quote-core
description: Faithful-core OS-command-injection sink using the REAL npm `shell-quote` quote() per version (pre-CVE-2021-42740 1.7.2 -> CVE-2021-42740 fix 1.7.3 [backtick via [A-z] escaped, TARGET] -> CVE-2026-9277 fix 1.8.4 [op line-terminator allowlist]). npm aliases hold all three versions side-by-side; the harness selects one by HARNESS_VER and builds a shell command with the REAL published quote(), then runs it via child_process.exec('/bin/sh -c ...').
